001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.command;
002
003import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
004
005import java.util.ArrayList;
006import java.util.Iterator;
007import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
008import java.util.List;
009import java.util.Locale;
010import java.util.Map;
011
012/**
013 * CommandParser is a utility class for parsing command arguments.
014 */
015public class CommandParser {
016
017  private final String raw;
018  private final List<String> args = new ArrayList<>();
019  private final Map<String, List<String>> colonArgs = new LinkedHashMap<>();
020
021  /**
022   * Parse a command string.
023   *
024   * @param raw raw command string - e.g. benefit add a b c d -tag:1 -tag:2 -foo:bar
025   */
026  public CommandParser(@NotNull final String raw, final boolean trimTail) {
027
028    this.raw = raw;
029    parse(trimTail);
030  }
031
032  /**
033   * Gets the all arguments.
034   *
035   * @return the all arguments. (benefit, a, b, c, d)
036   */
037  public List<String> getArgs() {
038
039    return args;
040  }
041
042  /**
043   * Gets the arguments started with `-`. E.g [[tag,1], [tag,2], [foo,bar]]
044   *
045   * @return the arguments started with `-`.
046   */
047  @NotNull
048  public Map<String, List<String>> getColonArgs() {
049
050    return colonArgs;
051  }
052
053  /**
054   * The raw command string.
055   *
056   * @return the raw command string.
057   */
058  @NotNull
059  public String getRaw() {
060
061    return raw;
062  }
063
064  private void parse(final boolean trimTail) {
065
066    explode(trimTail);
067    parseColon();
068  }
069
070  private void parseColon() {
071
072    final Iterator<String> it = args.iterator();
073    while(it.hasNext()) {
074      final String waiting = it.next();
075      if(!waiting.startsWith("-")) {
076        continue;
077      }
078      if(!waiting.contains(":")) {
079        continue;
080      }
081      final String[] spilt = waiting.split(":", 2);
082      if(spilt.length < 2) {
083        continue;
084      }
085      if(spilt[0].isEmpty() || spilt[1].isEmpty()) {
086        continue;
087      }
088      if(spilt[0].endsWith("\\")) {
089        continue;
090      }
091      it.remove();
092      final List<String> registered = colonArgs.getOrDefault(spilt[0], new ArrayList<>());
093      registered.add(spilt[1]);
094      colonArgs.put(spilt[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT), registered);
095    }
096  }
097
098  private void explode(final boolean trimTail) {
099
100    StringBuilder buffer = new StringBuilder();
101    for(final char c : raw.toCharArray()) {
102      if(c == ' ') {
103        final String newArg = buffer.toString();
104        buffer = new StringBuilder();
105        this.args.add(newArg);
106      } else {
107        buffer.append(c);
108      }
109    }
110    if(buffer.isEmpty() && !trimTail) {
111      this.args.add(buffer.toString());
112    } else if(!buffer.isEmpty()) {
113      this.args.add(buffer.toString());
114    }
115  }
116}
